commands.start: Fills out a form, question by question in DMs.
commands.list: Shows the forms you can fill out here.

unknownForm: {known, select, yes {No form by that name. Try {names}.} other {No forms here yet.}}
alreadyFilling: You're already filling out **{name}**. Finish it or reply `cancel`.
unreachable: I can't DM you and couldn't open a channel. Allow DMs from this community and try again.
introHint: Answer each question in a message. `cancel` stops.
hintChoice: Reply with the number or the option.
hintNumber: {range, select, both {Reply with a number from {min} to {max}.} min {Reply with a number of at least {min}.} max {Reply with a number up to {max}.} other {Reply with a number.}}
problemTooSmall: It has to be at least {min}.
problemTooShort: That's too short. At least {min} characters.
problemTooLong: That's too long. {max} characters at most.
problemChoice: Pick one of the options, by number or name.
expired: Your **{form}** timed out. Nothing was sent.
gone: That form is closed now. Nothing was sent.
submittedChannel: Sent. This channel closes in a minute.
reviewHint: React with {accept} to accept or {decline} to decline.
statusAccepted: {source, select, member {**Accepted** by {user}} other {**Accepted** by votes}}
statusDeclined: {source, select, member {**Declined** by {user}} other {**Declined** by votes}}
